# Read Primitives — Selective Aggregation

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Aggregate on a small subset of rows

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Aggregate on a small subset of rows */
SELECT
  SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS total_discount_amount
FROM lineitem
WHERE
  l_discount > 0.05 AND l_quantity < 24
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def aggregation_selective_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Aggregate on a small subset of rows."""
    col, lit = ctx.col, ctx.lit
    return (
        ctx.get_table("lineitem")
        .filter((col("l_discount") > lit(0.05)) & (col("l_quantity") < lit(24)))
        .select((col("l_extendedprice") * col("l_discount")).sum().alias("total_discount_amount"))
    )
```
